SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Fiction and Non - Fiction 2.3.1 Fiction: Novel from Kenya, part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 LITERATURE IN ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: how they relate with each other, ● discuss the characters and 1. Why is style important in writing of a novel?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. discuss the characters and characterisation from the set novel for literary analysis,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Fiction and Non - Fiction 2.3.1 Fiction: Novel from Kenya in the Kenya CBC curriculum.

   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. analyse the language and style used in the novel
